description: Presentation layer: automatic layout engine, reusable SVG symbol library + renderers (pneumatic + electrical/ladder), and a best-effort React+Vite UI. The core must remain testable headless; the renderer only draws a validated Circuit and never decides logic. Because the npm registry is BLOCKED (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY), React/Vite CANNOT be installed here; deliver the UI as source that compiles against the pipeline API and document that `npm install`/`vite` must be run in a networked environment. The layout engine and SVG string generation MUST be pure and unit-testable with zero deps. Depends on FEAT-002 (and FEAT-003).
steps: Implement src/layout: a pure automatic layout engine that receives the logical component/connection graph and assigns x, y, orientation, and line routing. No visual data stored in the logical circuit. Deterministic output for a given circuit. Unit-test that every component gets a position and that positions are within bounds / non-overlapping for a golden circuit.

Implement src/renderer with a reusable SVG symbol library returning SVG strings (framework-independent, no DOM required): CylinderSymbol, Valve52Symbol, Valve32NOSymbol, Valve32NCSymbol, MechanicalSensorSymbol, PneumaticANDSymbol, PneumaticORSymbol, SolenoidSymbol, RelayCoilSymbol, NOContactSymbol, NCContactSymbol, following PMR3407 port labels (P=1,A=2,B=4,R=3,S=5, pilots 10/12/14). renderer/pneumatic draws the pneumatic circuit; renderer/electrical draws the ladder (+24V/0V rails, numbered rungs, coils/contacts). Renderer consumes a laid-out, validated Circuit only.

Write tests/ (renderer/layout) that render a golden circuit to an SVG string and assert structural facts (contains <svg>, expected number of symbol groups, presence of each required symbol id/class, rung count for the ladder) - not pixel comparisons. Assert the renderer throws/refuses if given an unvalidated or invalid circuit.

Implement src/ui: React + TypeScript + Vite front end matching the requested screen (title 'GERADOR DE CIRCUITOS PMR3407', sequence input, Tipo Pneumatico/Eletropneumatico, Metodo Intuitivo/Cascata/Passo a passo, Modo Ciclo unico/Ciclo continuo, GERAR button; result tabs Circuito/Funcionamento/Etapas/Componentes/Verificacao; later Simular/Exportar SVG/PDF). The UI must call ONLY the pure pipeline API. Add vite config + index.html + package UI deps in a SEPARATE package section, and add a README section explaining the UI requires `npm install` in a networked environment (registry blocked in this sandbox).

Verify: run typecheck and full core test suite (layout + renderer tests must pass). Attempt UI dependency install ONLY to confirm the documented blocker; if it fails with 403, record that in findings and do NOT treat it as a task failure. Ensure the core (parser/engine/validator/layout/renderer as SVG strings/simulator/explanation) is fully runnable and tested without the UI.
acceptance_criteria: Layout engine is pure, deterministic, and unit-tested (every component positioned; no overlaps for the golden circuit).
SVG symbol library implements all 11 named symbol classes and produces valid SVG strings without a DOM/browser.
Renderer tests assert structural SVG facts for pneumatic and ladder outputs and pass; renderer refuses invalid circuits.
UI source exists implementing the specified screen and calls only the pipeline API; README documents the registry limitation for installing React/Vite.
`unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit` passes for the core and layout/renderer tests are green; the core is demonstrably runnable/testable without the web UI.
findings:
DONE. Implemented the presentation layer on branch feat/pmr3407-foundation.

DELIVERED:
- src/layout/ — pure, deterministic layout engine (engine.ts + types.ts + index.ts). Takes the logical Circuit graph, returns a SEPARATE LayoutResult (positions/orientation/orthogonal routing) and NEVER mutates the circuit. Grid-band placement by kind + natural id ordering; orthogonal (Manhattan) wire routing; synthetic anchors for implicit electric nodes (+24V/0V/R<n>).
- src/renderer/ — framework-independent SVG string library (no DOM). svg.ts (helpers), symbols.ts with ALL 11 named classes (CylinderSymbol, Valve52Symbol, Valve32NOSymbol, Valve32NCSymbol, MechanicalSensorSymbol, PneumaticANDSymbol, PneumaticORSymbol, SolenoidSymbol, RelayCoilSymbol, NOContactSymbol, NCContactSymbol) following PMR3407 port labels (P=1,A=2,B=4,R=3,S=5, pilots 10/12/14). guard.ts refuses invalid/unvalidated circuits via validateCircuit -> throws RenderRefusedError. renderer/pneumatic (cylinders/valves/solenoids/pipes) and renderer/electrical (+24V/0V rails, numbered rungs 1..N, coils, NO/NC contacts).
- src/pipeline.ts — pure generate() entrypoint (parser->solver->validator->layout->renderer->simulator/explanation); no React/DOM.
- src/ui/ — React+TS+Vite front end matching the requested screen EXACTLY (title GERADOR DE CIRCUITOS PMR3407; Sequencia; Tipo Pneumatico/Eletropneumatico; Metodo Intuitivo/Cascata/Passo a passo; Modo Ciclo unico/Ciclo continuo; GERAR; tabs Circuito/Funcionamento/Etapas/Componentes/Verificacao; Simular/Exportar SVG/Exportar PDF). Calls ONLY the pipeline facade. Kept OUT of the core tsconfig (has its own src/ui/tsconfig.json) + vite.config.ts + index.html + README 'User interface' section documenting the registry blocker.

TESTS: tests/layout/layout.test.ts (determinism, full placement, no-overlap, bounds, no-mutation, routing), tests/renderer/symbols.test.ts + renderer.test.ts (structural SVG facts, rung count, refusal path), tests/pipeline/pipeline.test.ts (end-to-end + graceful failures).

VERIFICATION (from /projects/sandbox, NODE_OPTIONS unset):
- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json: PASS (exit 0; core excludes src/ui).
- node --test: 87 tests pass, 0 fail (was 66 before FEAT-004; +21 new: layout 6, renderer symbols 5 + renderer 7, pipeline 3).

EXPECTED, DOCUMENTED LIMITATION (not a failure): `npm install` returns HTTP 403 (E403 for @types/react) because the sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY. React/Vite thus cannot be installed here; the UI is best-effort source and is excluded from the core typecheck so the core stays green. Documented in README. Extended types/node-shims.d.ts assert.throws to accept an error constructor (needed by the refusal-path test).
